info.title: Pricore API
info.description: REST API for managing a Pricore registry: organizations, repositories, packages, members, mirrors, and access tokens. Authenticate with a personal or organization access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

examples: This invitation has already been accepted.

get.summary: List organizations accessible to the authenticated token

post.summary: Create a new organization owned by the authenticated user

patch.description:
`tag_format` describes tags that release a single package, such as `{package}@{version}`
or `{path}/{version}`. Send `null` to treat every tag as a release of all packages.
patch.summary:
Update a repository's monorepo package paths and tag format. Omit `package_paths` to
leave them as they are, or send `null` to read the package from the repository root.
Packages outside the new paths are removed and a full sync is started
